notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
[b]We added Admin Mode:[/b]
R - Reload level
E - Open the next level if you're on the menu.
Q - Reset the levels.

[b]New Achievement.[/b]
-> To get it you need to click something in the menu.

[b]Have a good game![/b]
